ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the rhombus $ABCD$, the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$. Given that $AC = 8$ and $BD = 12$, what is the area of the rhombus $ABCD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In the rhombus $ABCD$, $AC=8$, $BD=12$,\\
since $AC\perp BD$,\\
therefore the area of the rhombus $ABCD$ $=\frac{1}{2}AC\cdot BD=\frac{1}{2}\times 8\times 12=\boxed{48}$.
